title: M4: finish John's ISO 9001 pack gap actions and sign-off evidence list
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/iso9001/JOHN-PACK-GAPS.md: 30 plain actions with proposed owner/timing, exact source sheet and actual evidence needed; all14 I7 feature-gap needs mapped and all18 builder5 source paths/revisions preserved. Covers scope/climate/applicability, policy/objectives, controlled docs/records, competence/gauges/suppliers/production/release/NC/effectiveness, required goods-out, measurements/audits/review, technical recovery and real SliQ control proof.

Completes the actionable list, not JNR's missing private records or certification. Existing private controls can close rows after evidence review; no claim that the company lacks them. Separate John/process/quality-checker/Rhys-Code/accounts signers; no invented dates/targets/results/acceptance. Needed current-work controls cannot be deferred for proposed future modules; audit/review dates follow actual obligations, not a made-up mandatory interval.

Read the18 public pack files; static checks pass for30 unique actions,14 gap mappings,18 source paths, blank approvals and whitespace. No company audit/meeting/test/calibration/training/transfer operation or certification claimed. Builder5 masters and ownership unchanged. One draft, no main merge, production SQL, Ready label, deployment or new feature. Exact head a23e3041e75ec5a90dc2bb66f68247614ea77c7f.
